# Pond5 Blog

> > The Pond5 Blog is a creative resource hub offering tutorials, tips, and insights for video editors, motion designers, and filmmakers working with Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, and stock media.

Published by Pond5, a leading stock media marketplace, this blog serves content creators with hands-on tutorials, workflow optimization tips, plugin reviews, and curated collections of archival footage. The content focuses on practical techniques for motion graphics, video editing, visual effects, and production best practices.

## Key Topics

- Adobe After Effects
- Adobe Premiere Pro
- Motion Graphics
- Video Editing
- Visual Effects
- Stock Footage
- Archival Content
- Color Grading
- Lumetri Color
- Video Production
- Premiere Pro Tutorials
- After Effects Tutorials
- VHS Effects
- Documentary Resources
- Retro Aesthetic

## Adobe Premiere Pro Tutorials

- [Social-Media Export Settings in Adobe Premiere Pro: The Ultimate Guide](https://blog.pond5.com/12628-social-media-export-settings-in-adobe-premiere-pro-the-ultimate-guide): Complete guide to export settings for YouTube, Vimeo, Facebook, and TikTok
- [How to Create the Classic VHS Look in Adobe Premiere](https://blog.pond5.com/72087-create-vhs-look-adobe-premiere): Tutorial for creating nostalgic VHS effects in Premiere Pro without AE
- [5 Underused Organizational Tools in Premiere Pro](https://blog.pond5.com/6478-5-underused-organizational-tools-in-premiere-pro): Workflow tips for project organization and management in Premiere Pro
- [Using a Track Matte Key for See-Through Graphics in Premiere Pro](https://blog.pond5.com/48515-track-matte-key-transparent-graphics): Tutorial on creating transparent text effects using track matte keys
- [15 FREE Camera Shake Presets for Premiere Pro and After Effects](https://blog.pond5.com/50565-15-free-camera-shake-presets): Free download of camera shake presets for Premiere Pro and After Effects

## After Effects Tutorials & Tips

- [Create Smooth Graphics By Fine-Tuning Your Keyframes in After Effects](https://blog.pond5.com/70157-smooth-graphics-keyframes-after-effects): Tutorial on keyframe interpolation and Bezier curves in After Effects
- [After Effects Pro Tip: Quit Using Gaussian Blur Forever](https://blog.pond5.com/30907-quit-using-gaussian-blur-in-after-effects): Pro tip on using Fast Blur and Box Blur alternatives to Gaussian Blur
- [After Effects Video Tutorial: Split and Slide](https://blog.pond5.com/1157-effects-video-tutorial-split-slide): Tutorial by Evan Abrams on creating split and slide effects in AE
- [Creating Quick Patterns in After Effects](https://blog.pond5.com/2012-creating-quick-patterns-in-after-effects): Tutorial on using repeater effects for dynamic pattern animations in AE
- [Quick Tip: Create Stills in After Effects](https://blog.pond5.com/30851-quick-tip-create-stills-in-after-effects): Quick tutorial on exporting still frames from After Effects compositions
